metadata.title: Parabolic frequency and backward uniqueness on compact Finsler metric measure spaces
metadata.abstract: We establish monotonicity formulas for parabolic frequency functions on closed Finsler metric measure spaces with fixed or evolving metrics and measures. When the reference measure is fixed, an integral bound on the metric variation yields monotonicity for the Finsler heat equation. For coupled metric measure flows, we construct positive global supersolutions and subsolutions of a linearized conjugate heat equation from local radial barriers. These weights define a frequency function whose monotonicity follows from an integral bound involving the metric variation and the change in weighted Ricci curvature. For parabolic equations with a source controlled by the solution and its gradient, we obtain a differential inequality for the frequency and prove that a solution vanishing at the terminal time must vanish throughout the preceding interval. The proof controls the comparison of the two weights through an energy quotient computed with the subsolution measure.

analysis.breakthrough: 对源项由解及其梯度控制的方程，推出终时刻消失则整个先前区间消失。
analysis.limitations: 需保留闭流形、各类积分变分界及源项控制。两权重的比较和线性化的适用条件需正文核对。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
